body: Orchestrator review of PR #353 (dotfiles-T128-project-map-reload-hook-a01: the project-map pane reloads through a Claude Code PostToolUse hook: home/dot_claude/hooks/executable_project-map-reload.sh, the claude.hooks key project_map_reload_hook in home/dot_agents/agent-config.yaml, the renderer's PostToolUse emission in scripts/generate-agent-configs.py, the regenerated home/.chezmoitemplates/claude-settings-managed.json, the parity block in scripts/check-agent-runtime.py, one sentence each in home/dot_config/claude/rules/project-map.md and home/dot_agents/skills/project-map/SKILL.md, and the tests in tests/unit/test_generate_agent_configs.py) ) at its final head: every item of the task's Files section is implemented and nothing else; the hook acts only on .project-map/index.html, selects the map's browser and tab from terminal-browser ls --all --json and drives that tab through the agent-browser binary with --cdp (tab <targetId>, then eval location.reload(); amendment 2), and exits 0 on every failure path; the Bot's single review (on PR open) and the local review and the audit of the final head are each fixed in the head or advisory, owned by the lineage's follow-up on main; the caps (200 changed lines outside tests/ and .orchestration/, 1000 under tests/) hold. Approved for the gate at the audited head.
